as_told.title: Multi-agency search for Michael Johnson, and how a fan's tip found him

plain: Mario Woods, a former Air Force guard at a nuclear weapons site who says he was abducted by aliens in 1977, says he spent decades and real money trying to find his partner from that night, Michael Johnson, searching even in hospitals and knowing only that Johnson said he was from Chicago. According to podcast host Jesse Michels, Woods hired private investigators, went to the FBI, and was promised help by AARO, the Pentagon's official UFO office, while amateur sleuths online also searched, all with no luck. Michels says a tip from a fan finally found Johnson, letting the two men, whose shared story would back each other up, meet again about 50 years later.
